steps.title: OPTIONAL: If you are not & …
steps.text: OPTIONAL: If you are not & want 70 Magic to burst Zombies and are confident going to DKS in Rune Armour, you can Iban Blast Rex for Berserker ring and some magic levels. Otherwise we do this after Barrows Gear. You can also alch at Rex waiting for them to spawn.

steps.title: Armoured Zombies drop the Zombie Axe …
steps.text: Armoured Zombies drop the Zombie Axe which is an excellent mid tier weapon (used until Abyssal Whip). It is advised to hunt for this now using Ice Burst (If 70 magic). The best way is buying Ice Sacks from LMS and using them in a PvP World. (IMPORTANT: ONCE YOU GET TO THE CAVE WITH THE ZOMBIES DO NOT CONTINUE THE QUEST BY LOOKING OVER THE LEDGES). Alternatively you can buy the runes.

steps.title: ANOTHER WARNING: DO NOT LOOK OVER …
steps.text: ANOTHER WARNING: DO NOT LOOK OVER THE LEDGES OR THE INSTANCE IS OVER AND YOU CAN GET BAGGED UP BY PKERS

steps.title: IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO SCOUT …
steps.text: IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO SCOUT THE LADDER WITH AN ALT TO MAKE SURE YOU DON'T GET BAGGED UP IF DOING PVP WORLD METHOD

steps.title: Also remember to change off PvP …
steps.text: Also remember to change off PvP world if you bank but you can stay on 1 trip for 1,000+ KC (over drop rate)

steps.title: Don't cast on Defensive. If you …
steps.text: Don't cast on Defensive. If you can get 78 Magic before Barrows you can build a Barrows Portal with a +5 red stew boost

steps.title: Another option is to complete Barrows …
steps.text: Another option is to complete Barrows before this and use the Runes from Barrows to burst the axe, but you may not have a barrows portal for Barrows which is slightly inefficient. The portal is not mandatory if you are not close. We only do a small bit of barrows.

steps.title: We are now going to do …
steps.text: We are now going to do some Barrows. There are many ways to get there so choose which you want or unlock it before starting. We are only after tank gear so probably don't need to do much more than 100 chests. Use Wind Wave. Morytania hard for more runes is locked behind 70 prayer so not worth doing at this stage. Kill 2 skeletons 1 bloodworm every run to maintain blood runes.
